title: Symmetric, rational and infinitely many $(23_4)$ configurations, and the end of the existence problem for geometric $(n_4)$ configurations
summary: A geometric $(n_4)$ configuration is a set of $n$ points and $n$ lines in the real projective plane such that every point lies on exactly four of the lines and every line contains exactly four of the points. The question of which $n$ admit such a configuration was posed by Grünbaum in 2000, and successive work of Bokowski, Grünbaum, Schewe, Pilaud and Cuntz settled every case but $n=23$. We settle this last case by bounding the symmetry of such configurations and classifying the most symmetric ones exactly.
